articles.headline: Accuray and Samsung NeuroLogica Advance Volumetric Imaging Collaboration for the Accuray CyberKnife Platform
articles.summary: Accuray announces agreements with Samsung NeuroLogica to pursue advanced volumetric imaging for CyberKnife. The development collaboration and planned capabilities are not represented as an already approved or commercially delivered new imaging product.
